name: ViewSeek VR & 3D Media Player
summary:
Keep your personal video collection on your own devices and watch it in VR. Choose which headset folders appear in your library, or pair with ViewSeek Library for Windows to stream over an encrypted connection on your home network. Local playback and PC pairing require no ViewSeek account.

Make yourself comfortable. Watch flat and 3D videos on an adjustable screen, or step into immersive 180° and 360° videos. Set your screen size, curve and position, customise controller shortcuts and resume where you left
